errors.text_span: 三个不同规模的图像映射文本特征网络
errors.evidence: The description states there are three different scales, but the chart shows four distinct parameter quantities (17M, 19M, 22M, 25M), represented by four bars.
The vertical axis is a category axis representing '参数量(M)' (Parameter Quantity), not a value axis. The bar lengths correspond to values on the horizontal axis.
The tick marks on the vertical axis are at 17, 19, 22, and 25. The intervals are not a constant 1M; they are 2M, 3M, and 3M.
The chart contains four horizontal bars, not three.

errors.text_span: 最左边的柱状图的长度约为17M
errors.evidence: This description fundamentally misunderstands the chart. It's a horizontal bar chart, so '最左边的' (leftmost) is not a valid way to identify a bar. Furthermore, the length of the bar represents the MR(%) value (approx. 83.1%), not the parameter quantity (17M).

errors.text_span: 该柱状图的峰值位于82%MR(%)处
errors.evidence: The value for the bar at 17M is approximately 83.1% MR(%), not 82%.

errors.evidence: The length of the bar represents the MR(%) value (approx. 83.7%), not the parameter quantity (22M). '中间柱状图' (middle bar) is also ambiguous as there are four bars.

errors.text_span: 该柱状图的峰值位于84%MR(%)处
errors.evidence: The value for the bar at 22M is approximately 83.7% MR(%), not 84%.

errors.text_span: 最右边的柱状图的长度约为25M
errors.evidence: This description incorrectly identifies a bar as '最右边的' (rightmost) in a horizontal bar chart. The length of this bar corresponds to the MR(%) value (approx. 83.5%), not the parameter quantity (25M).

The description fails to mention the chart's title, '3个数据集平均值' (Average value of 3 datasets), which provides crucial context that the MR values are averages.
The description only details three bars and completely omits the data for the 19M parameter quantity, which has an MR(%) value of approximately 83.4%.
